import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Convert sex and embarked to categorical variables
df['sex'] = pd.Categorical(df['sex'])
df['embarked'] = pd.Categorical(df['embarked'])

# Create a bar chart to show the survival rate by sex
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.countplot(x='sex', hue='survived', data=df)
plt.title('Survival Rate by Sex')
plt.xlabel('Sex')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Survived')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a histogram to show the age distribution of survivors and non-survivors
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.histplot(df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'], label='Survived', bins=10, alpha=0.5)
sns.histplot(df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'], label='Died', bins=10, alpha=0.5)
plt.title('Age Distribution of Survivors and Non-Survivors')
plt.xlabel('Age')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Survival Status')
plt.savefig('output_age.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a boxplot to compare the fare distribution of survivors and non-survivors
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.boxplot(x='survived', y='fare', data=df)
plt.title('Fare Distribution of Survivors and Non-Survivors')
plt.xlabel('Survival Status')
plt.ylabel('Fare')
plt.savefig('output_fare.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a scatterplot to show the relationship between fare and survival rate
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.scatterplot(x='fare', y='survived', data=df)
plt.title('Relationship between Fare and Survival Rate')
plt.xlabel('Fare')
plt.ylabel('Survival Rate')
plt.savefig('output_scatter.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
